description: Rents the server of an offer and starts it with a template. Billing starts right away and runs every minute until you stop or destroy it. Confirm the price with the user first. Needs instances:write. The response has the instance id; poll get_instance until status is running (usually 1–5 minutes).

disk_gb.description: Disk size, GB (use the template's recommended_disk_gb)

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying the same request, so a retry never rents twice

image.description: Docker image, only with the custom template

ssh_key_ids.description: SSH key ids to install (default: all of yours)

name: create_instance
title: Rent a GPU server
